entities.name: Secret Intelligence Service (MI6)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Britain's foreign intelligence agency, established in 1909 as the Secret Service Bureau. MI6 played critical roles in both World Wars, the Cold War, and counter-terrorism operations. Its organizational model — combining human intelligence (HUMINT), signals intelligence, and diplomatic cover operations — influenced intelligence agencies worldwide.
